A member's handover is written by the

A member's park is a marker in the

The host contract's crew store as files
in one directory: a place per name, a
file kept whole under a staging name
and 0600, and nothing read that is not
Martha [the code in src/, one directory per capability]
Every box is a directory in src/: the name is the capability, and its test sits beside it. These 7 directories are drawn nowhere on purpose:
check_a_range_before_the_owner_says_yes: the range check, verify_range (martha#256); a member's session cannot call it yet, because the launcher
registers no such tool, though it registers the crew's own (martha#253).
land_passed_work_as_one_batch: the batch landing and the fast-forward the owner's yes unlocks (martha#256); a member's session cannot call them yet,
because the launcher registers no such tool, though it registers the crew's own (martha#253).
open_and_finish_a_worktree: the two worktree tools, worktree_open and worktree_finish (martha#256); a member's session cannot call them yet, because the
launcher registers no worktree tool, though it registers the crew's own (martha#253).
read_the_origin_a_clone_has: what a clone's origin says, org/name and the default branch (martha#256); read by the three slices beside it, and by nothing that
probe_launch_hosts: a script run by hand, npm run probe:launch, to probe a host; the command never loads it.
record_mesh_answers: a script run by hand, npm run record:mesh-answers, when a version of the mesh server is recorded; the gate reads the answers it wrote,
record_claude_code_host: a script run by hand, npm run record:claude-code-host, when the host is upgraded; the adapter reads what it writes, and never runs it.
The crew ledger is drawn in the crew's own box because a lockup now loads it. record_mesh_server_tools is drawn because the launcher imports what it
recorded; the room itself is not built, and solo admits nothing, though every launch loads the node id, the tool list and the gates its slices hold.
